info.name: LifeFile - Queue and Patient APIs
info.description: Queue list, patient queue position, patient ETA, and patient-by-ID requests for the LifeFile Spring Boot API. Run requests in order: Login, Get current doctor profile, Get today's appointments, then the queue requests. Search for a patient before Get patient by ID. Protected requests use the token saved by Login.

request.description: Saves the returned JWT into the collection variable token.

exec: if (!data.token) throw new Error('Login response did not include a token');

request.description: Saves the profile ID as doctorId for Get queue list. Requires Login first.

exec: if (!id) throw new Error('Doctor profile response did not include _id or id');

request.description: Saves the first active appointment ID for the queue position and ETA requests. Requires Login first.

exec: if (!id) console.warn('No active appointment found; set appointmentId manually.');

request.description: Saves the first result's User ID as patientId. GET patient by ID accepts either a Patient profile ID or User ID. Requires Login first.

exec: const id = Array.isArray(patients) && patients.length ? (patients[0].id || patients[0]._id) : null;
if (!id) console.warn('No patient found; change patientSearch or set patientId manually.');

request.description: Returns nowServing, waitingQueue, totalWaiting, and queue positions. Run Get current doctor profile first.
Returns queuePosition and appointment status, plus the current serving token and estimated wait. Run Get today's appointments first.
Returns estimatedWait min/max and queue details for the appointment. Run Get today's appointments first.
Accepts either the Patient profile ID or the associated User ID. Run Search for a demo patient first. Requires Login and a Bearer token.

Saves the doctor's separate private clinic schedule. Run Setup > Login as demo doctor first. Edit the example days and hours before sending if needed. This request changes the saved profile schedule when executed.

exec: pm.test('Private clinic hours saved', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Response includes seven private schedule days', function () { pm.expect(doctor.privateSchedule.days).to.have.lengthOf(7); });
